name: assetflow
description: IT Asset Management System with Microservices Architecture

scripts.build:all: npm run build:users && npm run build:assets && npm run build:tickets && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:users: cd users-service && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:assets: cd assets-service && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:tickets: cd tickets-service && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:gateway: cd gateway-service && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend-service && npm install && npm run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf users-service/dist assets-service/dist tickets-service/dist gateway-service/dist frontend-service/dist
